concepts.title: Nightglass Courier
concepts.character: A magnetic, cool-headed male courier, age24: fine angular jaw, long narrow dark eyes, straight blue-black hair swept away from one eye, lean long-legged build; a restrained half-smile.
concepts.costume: Pearl-white cropped technical jacket, high-neck black undershirt, charcoal tapered trousers, a single red cord at the waist, slim segmented gloves. A crescent-shaped glass cutter floats beside his hand.
concepts.environment: A dense rain-wet elevated city of stacked skybridges and vertical gardens, clear midnight architecture with cyan signage-like light but no letters.
concepts.monster: A huge translucent obsidian manta with six luminous circular eyes along its broad wings, gliding between bridges; readable complete silhouette.
concepts.rendering: Precise tapered digital ink, beautiful economical facial drawing, crisp two-step cel shadows and luminous edge light; smooth clear color, almost no surface texture. Modern aspirational action-comic finish.
concepts.palette: Indigo, pearl white, electric cyan and one scarlet accent.

concepts.title: Sunbreak Lancer
concepts.character: A fearless female rooftop lancer, age23: freckles, warm tan skin, broad lively grin, strong eyebrows, long copper braid, compact athletic sprinter build.
concepts.costume: Red sleeveless wrap top, cream wide shorts over fitted leggings, mismatched striped shin guards and a very long green spear; practical, graphic, unarmored silhouette.
concepts.environment: Sun-bleached stepped rooftops crowded with enormous wind kites and angular awnings under brilliant blue sky.
concepts.monster: An agile mirror-glass tiger whose body is assembled from broad triangular reflections, bounding over a roof; four clearly readable legs and a ribbon tail.
concepts.rendering: Elastic hand-drawn action linework, strong foreshortening, broad flat bright colors, bold impact-shaped shadows, exuberant expressive face; little rendering or hatching.
concepts.palette: Tomato red, sky blue, sunflower yellow and fresh green.

concepts.title: Salt Crown
concepts.character: An imposing female salt knight, age46: square weathered face, olive skin, shaved sides with one long white braid, heavy powerful build, composed amused expression.
concepts.costume: Broad layered white salt-ceramic shoulder plates over dark woven cloth, a short split armored skirt, huge iron boots and a blunt rectangular cleaver; no cape.
concepts.environment: A vast blinding salt basin with stepped black basalt wells and tiny rope bridges, severe open horizon and deep dry shadows.
concepts.monster: A monumental shell-backed salt crab rising from the white crust, with asymmetrical mineral shelves and long black stilt legs.
concepts.rendering: Opaque oil-paint brush masses, sculptural faces, lost-and-found edges, visible bristle marks and large simplified value blocks; richly painted, no contour-ink overlay.
concepts.palette: Chalk white, burnt umber, cobalt shadow and oxidized copper.

concepts.title: Velvet Duelist
concepts.character: An elegant male duelist, age27: graceful long oval face, delicate nose, deep-set violet eyes, long wine-red hair loosely tied, slim dancer build, knowingly charming smile.
concepts.costume: Plum velvet waistcoat, ivory poet sleeves, slim high-waisted trousers, small pearl ear ornament, ornate narrow rapier; an elegant open silhouette rather than armor.
concepts.environment: A moonlit stained-glass conservatory, curling iron staircases, giant pale flowers and fractured colored light.
concepts.monster: A sinuous orchid serpent with a white petal hood and branching translucent antlers, coiling around the conservatory columns.
concepts.rendering: Delicate calligraphic contour, airy watercolor washes, ornamental negative space and refined romantic facial stylization; graceful long curves and selective jewel-like detail.
concepts.palette: Burgundy, pale lilac, ivory and moonlit turquoise.

concepts.title: Iron Orchard
concepts.character: A resourceful female mechanic, age29: angular cheekbones, olive complexion, short indigo pompadour, sturdy shoulders, raised eyebrow and a crooked confident smile.
concepts.costume: Loose olive overalls tied at the waist, cream cropped work shirt, oversized orange mechanical gauntlets, heavy boots and a narrow tool belt.
concepts.environment: An orchard grown through a rust-orange railway scrapyard, old overhead wires and a bright cloudy afternoon.
concepts.monster: A massive segmented harvesting centipede made from rounded train-engine shells, with articulated pruning claws and a glowing green front window.
concepts.rendering: Hand-painted animation backgrounds with opaque gouache, clean slightly thick cels, simple hard-edged shadow shapes, subtle painted color variation; distinctly retro 2D animation, not 3D.
concepts.palette: Rust orange, faded olive, denim blue and cream.

concepts.title: Floodline Detective
concepts.character: A sardonic male canal investigator, age41: broad broken nose, cropped beard, one white eyebrow streak, close-shaved hair, solid barrel-chested build, tired amused eyes.
concepts.costume: Rolled white shirt sleeves, black suspenders, dark waterproof work apron, heavy trousers and a hooked steel baton.
concepts.environment: A flooded concrete canal underpass with stark bridge piers, ladder shadows and tiny distant street lamps.
concepts.monster: A long faceless eel formed from overlapping black umbrellas, ribs splaying into legs as it emerges from the water.
concepts.rendering: High-contrast brush-ink noir: enormous pure black shapes, stark white faces, dry brush splashes, angular composition, no gray airbrush; a single hot-pink accent.
concepts.palette: Black, white and restrained hot pink only.

concepts.title: Jade Signal
concepts.character: A quick-witted female signal runner, age25: dark skin, triangular face, lime-green geometric bob, tall slender build, wide bright smile.
concepts.costume: A sleeveless geometric navy vest, oversized coral culottes, white ankle wraps, a circular jade throwing ring; large simple costume shapes.
concepts.environment: An impossible bamboo sky-temple made from suspended flat terraces, round sun discs and long hanging ladders.
concepts.monster: A tall three-ring crane creature: three nested circular torso forms balanced on two extremely long legs, a flat spear beak and a fan tail.
concepts.rendering: Strictly lineless 2D graphic illustration, cut geometric silhouettes, flat solid color, carefully composed negative space; no gradients, painterly lighting, texture, detailed muscles or 3D volume.
concepts.palette: Mint, coral, navy, jade and warm cream.

concepts.title: Ember Dancer
concepts.character: A charismatic male festival fighter, age26: medium-brown skin, rounded nose, loose auburn curls, lithe muscular dancer build, warm laughing expression.
concepts.costume: A sleeveless garnet tunic, loose saffron sash trousers, bare forearms, soft wrapped boots and two small bronze fans.
concepts.environment: A spring market built on shallow flooded terraces, wooden footbridges, bright paper lanterns reflected in daylight.
concepts.monster: An enormous cracked porcelain koi with ember light between its plates and broad flowing fins, swimming through the market air.
concepts.rendering: Loose lively ink with irregular watercolor blooms, warm transparent washes, gestural drawing, soft broken edges and white paper breathing through; inviting rather than grim.
concepts.palette: Saffron, garnet, pale aqua and warm paper white.

concepts.title: Bone Radio
concepts.character: A confrontational female sound hunter, age32: dark skin, shaved head, bold geometric scalp tattoos, heavy lower jaw, rangy muscular build, ferocious delighted grin.
concepts.costume: A huge magenta bomber jacket with torn sleeves, lime utility harness, black stomping boots and a long microphone pole with a circular cage head.
concepts.environment: A quarry filled with improvised radio towers, hanging cables and jagged concrete platforms.
concepts.monster: A loping four-armed ape-like beast built from speaker cones and knotted cable sinews, an enormous rectangular mouth grille.
concepts.rendering: Raw angular scratchy cartoon ink, coarse halftone dots, torn-paper shapes, deliberately rough misregistered spot colors and aggressive graphic faces; underground punk-comic energy.
concepts.palette: Acid lime, dirty magenta, black and paper white.

concepts.title: Porcelain Warden
concepts.character: A commanding female palace warden, age35: pale skin, broad high cheekbones, thick straight red hair in a sharp fan-shaped updo, statuesque build, cool direct gaze.
concepts.costume: Architectural teal lacquer armor with wide rounded sleeves, ivory waist panels and one enormous folding fan shield; elegant solid masses.
concepts.environment: A bright tile palace of turquoise courtyards, reflecting pools and floating red bridges.
concepts.monster: A towering porcelain peacock creature whose giant fan is made of fractured ivory blade-feathers with isolated gold eye markings.
concepts.rendering: Stylized opaque digital painting with crisp ornamental shapes, broad confident brush planes, rich matte color and limited polished accents; dimensional painted faces without scratchy line hatching.
concepts.palette: Turquoise, ivory, vermilion and restrained gold.

concepts.title: Moonward Ink
concepts.character: A stoic male mountain keeper, age52: stocky thick-necked build, broad flat nose, short gray beard, heavy lids, cropped hair and a quietly compassionate expression.
concepts.costume: A dense cross-woven poncho over loose dark robes, rope-fastened boots and a crooked reed staff; simple humble shapes.
concepts.environment: A snowbound cedar forest with steep black trunks and a narrow shrine path, stark empty sky.
concepts.monster: A huge eyeless moth-deer, with broad ragged moth wings, six slender legs and a soft blank head, looming silently among the trunks.
concepts.rendering: Black-and-white dry-brush manga with powerful imperfect ink strokes, sparse fine contour, deep blacks against untouched white paper and expressive rugged adult faces; no color or gray photographic textures.
concepts.palette: Pure black, white and sparse ink wash.

concepts.title: Honeycomb Runner
concepts.character: A cheerful female rooftop beekeeper, age30: adult proportions, round mature cheeks, warm brown skin, thick dark hair in two bundled braids, solid average build, confident friendly smile.
concepts.costume: A textured honey-colored felt rain jacket, cobalt work boots, patterned wool trousers and a glass-and-brass honey backpack.
concepts.environment: A rooftop garden village built from hand-shaped clay chimneys, stitched fabric awnings and real-looking miniature plants.
concepts.monster: A giant moss-covered clay toad carrying a colony of brass beetles on its broad back, with obvious crafted joints and expressive glass eyes.
concepts.rendering: Tactile stop-motion puppet concept art: sculpted clay adult face, visible wool and felt fibers, handmade miniature environment, soft practical studio light, shallow but sufficient depth of field. Clearly an adult, not a toy child.
concepts.palette: Honey yellow, cobalt, moss green and terracotta.

concepts.title: Red Current
concepts.character: A fiercely focused male impact boxer, age24: tan skin, black buzz cut, compact angular face, strong muscular neck and explosive athletic build; a competitive teeth-baring grin.
concepts.costume: White sleeveless athletic windbreaker, black fitted fight trousers, vivid red hand wraps and oversized angular sparring gauntlets.
concepts.environment: A vast spiral concrete skateway around a tidal turbine, sweeping speed geometry and bright open sky.
concepts.monster: A cyclone creature made of interlocked sharp white paper shark forms, moving as one huge spiral body around the turbine.
concepts.rendering: Clean muscular black-and-white sports/action manga linework, bold perspective, precise anatomy, kinetic tapered speed marks and one vermilion spot color; no full-color painting.
concepts.palette: Black, white and vermilion only.

concepts.title: Astral Seamstress
concepts.character: A dreamy but determined female star tailor, age23: long narrow face, luminous brown eyes, very long lavender hair, slender upright build, soft mischievous smile.
concepts.costume: An asymmetric lavender ruffled coat over a fitted midnight dress, elegant long boots and a giant silver sewing needle with floating thread loops.
concepts.environment: Suspended textile bridges and immense translucent curtains between star-lit towers, a spacious luminous sky.
concepts.monster: A graceful astrolabe moth leviathan with circular brass wing frames filled by translucent nebula-colored silk.
concepts.rendering: Airy fashion-comic linework, elongated elegant proportions, soft luminous gradients, delicate facial features and flowing ribbon shapes; crisp selective sparkle, generous pale space rather than dense detail.
concepts.palette: Lavender, rose quartz, midnight blue and pearl.

concepts.title: Cathedral Engine
concepts.character: A proud male bell engineer, age37: copper-brown skin, bald head, long sculpted moustache, broad stern face, powerful thick forearms, wry raised brow.
concepts.costume: White brocade lapels over a dark fitted work coat, brass elbow braces, narrow striped trousers and a circular bell shield.
concepts.environment: A vertical mechanical city of giant exposed clock gears, masonry arches and huge silent bell chambers.
concepts.monster: An enormous inverted walking bell with four jointed clapper legs and layered ear-like metal fins; entirely original mechanical anatomy.
concepts.rendering: Antique copperplate engraving language: precise crosshatching, elaborate controlled contour, sculpted light through line density, flat parchment ground and selective metallic spot color; no painterly blur.
concepts.palette: Parchment, black ink and aged brass.

concepts.title: Tidewalker
concepts.character: A fearless female reef harvester, age38: plus-size powerful body, warm brown skin, broad nose, full lips, thick blue-black braid and an open joyful laugh.
concepts.costume: A cropped ceramic vest, high-waisted magenta trousers, wrapped sandals and a curved coral harvesting scythe.
concepts.environment: A sunlit reef market with white stairs, blue pools, clustered pottery and coral-grown balconies.
concepts.monster: A translucent umbrella jellyfish joined to a huge armored turtle shell, with broad trailing tentacles and a calm immense face.
concepts.rendering: Bold matte gouache illustration, chunky opaque brush shapes, dry paint edges, simplified expressive anatomy and strong flat shadows; vivid handmade color, no shiny digital finish.
concepts.palette: Ultramarine, magenta, coral and chalk white.

concepts.title: Hollow Cartographer
concepts.character: An inquisitive male mapmaker, age30: medium-brown skin, long slightly crooked nose, small square spectacles, short neat brown hair, slim build and an alert amused expression.
concepts.costume: A rust turtleneck, mint knee-length parka, cream straight trousers, brown boots and an oversized circular map case.
concepts.environment: A terracotta city built inside a series of giant open arches, distant aqueducts and carefully legible stairways.
concepts.monster: A walking island creature with six long tree-root legs, a smooth turtle-like landmass body and tiny trees on its back.
concepts.rendering: Uniform clean contour widths, flat colors with very sparse shadows, carefully drawn architecture, readable small details and warm expressive adult cartoon faces; classic clear-line adventure language.
concepts.palette: Terracotta, mint, cream and sky blue.

concepts.title: Soft Thunder
concepts.character: A boisterous female storm wrestler, age27: adult broad face, short pink locs, stocky powerlifter build, huge expressive eyebrows and a contagious laugh.
concepts.costume: Turquoise wrestling singlet, loose orange joggers, thick white belt and enormous brick-shaped gauntlets; simple dynamic graphic outfit.
concepts.environment: Rolling green orchards with enormous windmills and rounded storm clouds, bright open rolling terrain.
concepts.monster: An inflated whale-serpent with tiny powerful wings, elastic blue body, orange cheek sacs and a comically enormous determined face.
concepts.rendering: Bold western 2D animation design, thick changing contour, exaggerated muscular shape rhythm, squash-and-stretch energy and simple cel shadows; unmistakably adult character proportions.
concepts.palette: Turquoise, orange, grass green and pink.

concepts.title: Black Petal
concepts.character: An enigmatic androgynous male botanist, age28: porcelain skin, sharp long cheekbones, dark almond eyes, hair sharply divided into white and black halves, slim elegant build, unsettling small smile.
concepts.costume: A cropped black tailored jacket, high-waisted pleated black trousers, a white geometric collar, one long silver glove and a thin thorn whip.
concepts.environment: A glass greenhouse standing in a desert of blood-red grass beneath a stark pale sky.
concepts.monster: A gigantic orchid predator on many delicate root legs, translucent black petals opening around a luminous white hollow; eerie without gore.
concepts.rendering: Refined nearly realistic fashion facial drawing, razor-clean thin contours, silky restrained gradients, graphic black shapes and sparse surreal botanical detail; sophisticated eerie beauty.
concepts.palette: Black, bone white, silver and deep crimson.

concepts.title: Starforge Nomad
concepts.character: A resilient male asteroid prospector, age44: dark skin, square mature face, broad nose, close-cropped hair, full short beard, stout powerful adult build and a stubborn confident grin.
concepts.costume: Chunky ivory-and-lime space armor, huge square boots, a short violet tool sash and a heavy pixel-geometric mining hammer.
concepts.environment: A shattered asteroid foundry with huge suspended stone platforms, lava channels and a deep navy starfield.
concepts.monster: A colossal segmented moonworm made of square luminous mineral plates, curling behind the platforms with a broad split-ring mouth.
concepts.rendering: Genuine deliberate hand-pixel-art construction, hard square pixel clusters, limited color ramps, no antialiasing or soft painted edges, richly designed sprite-like adult portrait and clear isometric environment. Preserve visible crisp pixels at full image scale.
concepts.palette: Deep navy, electric lime, violet, lava orange and ivory.
